value.rationale: The kinetic parameters and pulse timing are motivated by an accessible 2023 bacterial-persister treatment paper; the all-positive-parameter on-treatment waking threshold and universal independence from all pulse durations are structural facts, not a routine numeric optimum. The all-order resonance supplies a new precise boundary where scheduling stops mattering even though matrices need not commute. It can help test whether equal-exposure pulse rearrangements yield qualitatively different simulated growth and whether a resuscitation-promoting intervention changes the preferred ordering. This remains theoretical and not a clinical treatment recommendation.
